hotels.title: Classic Venetian Elegance Beside the Grand Canal with Fine Dining Restaurant & Bar
hotels.description: Step into Venetian elegance just moments from Piazzale Roma and the Grand Canal, where lush gardens and palatial decor create a serene oasis. Dine on Venetian specialities at Giardino D'Inverno beneath a living canopy of vines and flowers, or sip on a crafted cocktail at the Lounge Bar. Explore nearby treasures like the Basilica dei Frari and the Scuola Grande di San Rocco, and arrange a gondola ride for an authentic Venice experience. Stay connected and share holiday snaps with complimentary Wi-Fi, while the banquet hall provides a refined setting for special gatherings.
